macros.name: includecode
macros.doc: Includes an external file that will be highlighted according to the syntax rules of the language.

macros.name: pygment
macros.doc: This macro takes the code in the second argument and feeds it to pygmentize, so that it outputs code highlighted to the rules of the first argument.

envs.name: pygmented
envs.doc: For longer snippets of code it is usually better to use the pygmented environment. The parameter is the language that the snippet is in, so it can be highlighted properly.
